name: HDPJoin Discovery Analytics
business_purpose: Provide consent-aware HDPJoin funnel analytics to authorized HDP services through SACO's existing read-only google_analytics connector backed by GoogleAnalyticsCollector-CDK.

ga4.note: Existing HDP property; verify GA4 hostname and conversion event collection in production, including www alias behavior.

gsc.note: sc-domain:hdpjoin.com visible via direct Search Console API with Restricted access. Sitemap submitted. GSC search metrics are not yet included in the new SACO GA4 aggregate.

requested_capabilities.name: analytics.hdpjoin.fetch
requested_capabilities.output: aggregate GA4 sessions, page_views, active_users and event counts; no per-visitor data

requested_capabilities.name: discovery.referrals.fetch
requested_capabilities.note: Attribution by destination requires validated GA4 custom dimensions and downstream conversion evidence.

output.privacy: aggregate only; no raw IP, email, token, full URL query, or respondent data

operator_actions: DONE: authenticated localhost SACO HTTP app.invoke (invalid key 401; valid request 200; evidence recorded)
DONE: live Search Console fixed sc-domain:hdpjoin.com settled date aggregate included in existing HDPJoin GA4 report
DONE: local private offline HTML dashboard refreshed by collector report module
NEXT: one genuine consented HDPJoin browser visit (advisor choice, HDP link, newsletter interest); verify named GA4 events through CDK/SACO after processing
NEXT: check Search Console sitemap pending→processed and indexed page counts, then demand evidence
NEXT: confirm next unattended six-hour dashboard refresh and state freshness
NEXT: do not expose operator token or internal analytics to external tenants without tenant-scoped authorization, quotas, auditing and reviewed HTTPS route
NEXT: newsletter double opt-in + unsubscribe backend remains independent

reporting.collection: Generated by the existing HDP-GoogleAnalyticsCollector-CDK service at collector cycle (~6 hours), plus manual first-run production receipt
reporting.source: Google Analytics property 553736139, GA4 Data API
reporting.events: allowlisted named aggregate counts; all unrecognized event names discarded
reporting.completeness: today is partial; last_7d and last_28d end yesterday
reporting.freshness: SACO fails closed if report is older than 36 hours
reporting.credentials: Google service account exclusively accessed by collector-side report generator

search_console.query_mode: date-only Search Analytics / final settled dates
search_console.windows: last_7d and last_28d end prior day; today explicitly not_final
search_console.status_semantics: ok / no_data / unavailable / not_final; never invents rankings, query terms, or clicks
search_console.source: HDP GoogleAnalyticsCollector-CDK direct Google Search Console API

private_dashboard.generated_by: existing collector report module; local file only, no HTTP route
private_dashboard.refresh: same collector cycle as private aggregate, manual first generation confirmed; scheduled unattended update pending verification
private_dashboard.security: no external scripts, keys, user identifiers, raw URLs or search phrases
